ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes setup and cleanup time (price list). The halls have 8-hour, 12-hour and 24-hour rates; night-time or 24-hour use may not be available depending on the bookings before and after, so consult in advance. Except for some areas, the venue can be used 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Advance arrival of packages is in principle designated for the day before the event, and an advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the load-in date (valuables are not accepted, and the venue takes no responsibility for damage to packages). Large or numerous packages not notified in advance are treated as renting the venue as a storage space for a fee. (Source: Hall price list, updated July 3, 2026; FAQ; Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 20)
ops.loadingHours: When there is load-in or load-out, an advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the work date (the loading area cannot be used if it is not submitted). Delivery vehicles for load-in and load-out must enter and leave from the designated place within the usage time, and the venue may adjust load-in times and the like. Loading and unloading work is in principle limited to 20 minutes. The permitted dimensions of the loading area are 3,200 mm high x 7,000 mm long. The load-in route differs by hall: for 2F, from the B2 "Bellesalle-only parking" via the load-in elevator (entrance door 900 mm wide x 2,300 mm high; inside the car 1,200 mm wide x 2,450 mm high x 1,400 mm deep; load capacity 900 kg); for B1, from the B1F loading area (entrance 2,500 mm wide x 3,150 mm high); for 1F, directly from the north-side load-in entrance along the road (2,500 mm wide x 3,000 mm high; a road use permit is required). The on-site manager must complete entry procedures at the Sumitomo Fudosan Akihabara Building 1F Service Center before starting work. The building entrance is open 7:30-20:00. Packages received in advance are in principle limited to 5 boxes per hall. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice (Event Hall), Event Hall equipment list [B1F and 1F updated September 11, 2026; 2F updated October 27, 2026], Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 16)
ops.vehicleRules: The loading area is used only for loading and unloading; if parking is needed, use an outside parking lot. When multiple vehicles are used, they share one vehicle's loading space in staggered turns. Illegal parking, parking outside the designated parking lot, and roadside parking around the building are strictly prohibited. Products, packing materials, decoration materials, trash and the like may not be left in the loading area during the usage period. If delivery vehicle traffic is expected to be congested, traffic staff are placed at the entrance and similar points. The vehicle restrictions in the equipment list are: for 2F and B1, 3,200 mm high x 7,000 mm long and 2.0 t; for 1F, outdoors and 2.0 t (a road use permit is required). (Source: Advance Load-in Notice (Event Hall), Terms of Use 2026ver2 Articles 15 and 16, Event Hall equipment list)
ops.parking: The parking column of the equipment list shows "none" for Bellesalle-only parking, hourly parking and drop-off area alike, and the venue advises using nearby parking. To find nearby hourly parking lots, search for "Bellesalle Akihabara" on "s-park" (Tokyo Metropolitan Road Improvement and Conservation Corporation), which is linked from the official facility page. (Source: Official facility page, Event Hall equipment list [B1F and 1F updated September 11, 2026; 2F updated October 27, 2026])
ops.waitingRooms: There are 3 waiting rooms: 2F Waiting Room A (15㎡), 2F Waiting Room B (9㎡) and B1 Waiting Room (20㎡). All have a usage fee of 0 yen and a private restroom. Waiting rooms cannot be used on their own. The waiting room column for the 1F Hall shows "none". (Source: Official facility page, Event Hall equipment list)
ops.catering: Outside food/drink brought in is allowed. However, if a caterer other than the operator's designated vendors is used, an "outside food/drink fee" applies (party use only; bringing in drinks only or boxed meals is not covered, and the Event Space is not covered). The amount depends on venue area: up to 300㎡ 100,000 yen, up to 600㎡ 200,000 yen, up to 900㎡ 300,000 yen, up to 1,200㎡ 400,000 yen, 1,201㎡ and above 500,000 yen (110,000 to 550,000 yen each, tax included). Party menus for receptions are introduced on the website of Izumi Restaurant, a Sumitomo Fudosan Group company. (Source: Outside Food/Drink Fee Guide PDF, FAQ, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 4)
